newsitem.title: USA: Community Care engages Smith Barney.
newsitem.headline: Community Care engages Smith Barney.

text.p: NAPLES, Fla., Oct 9 (Reuter) Community Care of America Inc, a provider of community-based healthcare services in rural areas, said on Wednesday that it has engaged the investment banking firm of Smith Barney Inc as its financial adviser to assist Community Care of America in evaluating strategic alternatives for enhancing shareholder value, including the possible sale of the company.

"We recognize the importance of evaluating all alternatives to enhance Community Care's value for our shareholders and are continuing to actively explore all possible strategic or financial transactions, including equity and debt placements as well as the sale of the entire Company," said Gary W. Singleton, president and chief executive of Community Care of America Inc.

The company now owns, leases or manages 72 service operations, which includes 54 long-term care facilities, two rural hospitals, three physician practices, four clinics, one home health care agency, one child day care center and six assisted living units.
